decisions.reason: The migration workflow does not change the independent constraint that pasted content remain within page margins.
The migration workflow does not modify the required ability to insert manual line breaks after pasted content.
Applying available styles during migration does not change their required PBU naming, language, or coverage.
The migration workflow does not resolve or alter the table and right-column layout requirements or their existing ambiguity.
The workflow instruction to apply available styles does not change any bullet appearance or level-four variant requirement.
Using available new-template styles during migration does not change the independently required style-system specification or its all-template coverage.
The migration workflow does not alter numbered-list alignment behavior or the item-10 constraint.
Applying styles after migration does not necessarily change the required Tab-driven hierarchy behavior or resolve its existing ambiguity.
The content-migration workflow does not change the supported Word environment or general operational-reliability constraint.
The migration workflow does not entail any change to title-field formatting preservation.
The migration steps do not change the independent one-page fit target or required spacing adjustment.
The migration workflow does not change document content language or default template language.
